purpose: Non-admission discovery of ten product-specific public property valuation, cadastral building crosswalk, construction-cost, insurer-distribution, historical exposure and post-disaster recovery data sources; original data bytes and actual insured exposures remain excluded.

entries.name: New Zealand LINZ public National District Valuation Roll subset
entries.provider: Toitu Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ)
entries.spatial_scope: New Zealand; only territorial authorities permitting public publication; not a complete national valuation roll
entries.temporal_scope: Public table updated weekly; official page last updated 2026-07-23 at source inspection
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Non-spatial property valuation table with unit_of_property_id, valuation and property descriptors; approximately 287,243 publicly listed rows on inspected source page, dependent on current version and related LINZ tables
entries.note: Publisher explicitly differentiates this public partial CC BY 4.0 table from government-only full National DVR. Owner/ratepayer information is excluded. The table itself has null/empty geometries, so a verified unit_of_property_id to separately licensed spatial table join is required before asset geolocation. Tax/rating value is not insured replacement cost, TIV, market value or actual carrier exposure; preserve authority participation/selection bias and valuation date. No raw records acquired or committed. Official NZ Property Boundaries layer 122657 contains unit_of_property_id; Property-Building Reference table 119620 joins unit_of_property_id to building_id; NZ Building Outlines layer 101290 contains that building_id. Each must be pinned to compatible vintages and checked for selection, null keys and one-to-many relations. The provider category listing was updated in late October 2026 with approximately 288K public DVR rows, while the detailed earlier source page listed 287,243 rows in July; the differing dates are not a real joined coverage estimate.

entries.name: Manitoba ROLL ENTRY assessed-property GIS layer
entries.spatial_scope: Province of Manitoba, Canada; jurisdictional assessment coverage, not all Canada or a verified footprint inventory
entries.temporal_scope: Official Canada open-data record updated 2026-03-11; individual ASMT_ROLL valuation tax year and version vary by record
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Parcel/roll boundaries and summary assessment fields, including municipality, civic/short legal address, DWELLING_UNITS, TOTAL_VALUE and assessment version; listed CSV, GeoJSON, GeoPackage and ArcGIS FeatureServer access
entries.note: A ROLL ENTRY is an assessed-property or parcel unit, not one building, insured location or loss. TOTAL_VALUE is a tax-assessment measure, not replacement cost/TIV. The publisher describes a civic or legal-location field and parcel-like geometry: assess personal-data risk and record-level exclusions before any acquisition; no property-owner or policy inference. Verify the current ArcGIS service schema, geometry quality, rate-year versions and the dataset-specific rights statement. No third-party bytes stored. Canada open-data catalogue expressly names OpenMB Information and Data Use License. Government's official terms allow commercial reuse, adaptation and redistribution with attribution, but exempt personal information and unlicensed third-party rights. This is a source-rights ceiling, not project admission; civic address exposure and record-level PII need a separate documented review. Original FeatureServer identifies MG_ROLL_ENTRY_POLY geometry and EPSG:26914; metadata access is observed, but no live row/count query success was verified in this research.

entries.name: Eurostat quarterly construction producer price/cost index for new residential buildings
entries.spatial_scope: Reporting European countries with available Eurostat quarterly series; country-level, not city/building-level rates
entries.temporal_scope: Official quarterly series sts_copi_q, with source catalogue showing updates in October 2026 and historical coverage varying by country
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Eurostat SDMX/CSV quarterly national index series for construction producer prices or costs of new residential buildings; associated view teiis510
entries.note: An index of cost change is not an absolute EUR/m2 reconstruction price, per-building insured sum, actual claims inflation or non-residential cost series. Preserve units, base-year rebasings, seasonal adjustment, country gaps, residential NACE code and vintage when applying to separate independently justified replacement value priors. Source data are not copied here.

entries.name: IVASS geographic distribution of Italian insurance premiums, reference year 2024
entries.provider: IVASS - Istituto per la Vigilanza sulle Assicurazioni
entries.spatial_scope: Italy; geography published by the Italian insurance supervisor, not verified individual insurer risk-site geocodes
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Regulator statistical publication and downloadable XLSX tables on geographic premium distribution; exact regional/class and entity dimensions require workbook inspection
entries.note: Only the published report topic, 2024 reference year, 2026 date and XLSX availability were checked. Per-carrier, per-peril, regional granularity and workbook values were not independently verified. Premium collection geography does not identify insured asset coordinates, building counts, TIV, claims or ceded reinsurance share. Do not infer insurer-specific geographic allocation without confirmed table dimensions.

entries.name: OpenFEMA Public Assistance Funded Projects Details v2
entries.provider: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), United States
entries.spatial_scope: United States federally supported public-assistance disaster recipients and eligible facilities; excludes most private insurance claims
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously updated OpenFEMA v2 public data; obligated projects only, with ongoing historic migration and revisions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Project worksheet and applicant-linked obligations; public OpenFEMA v2 REST API and published data dictionary, not directly site-level validated insured losses
entries.note: FEMA explicitly warns that these grant obligations are from grant-management systems, not official federal financial reporting or complete economic damages. Project worksheets are only funded/obligated work and may cover debris or mitigation, not physical replacement. Data migration changed record counts; do not treat v1 and v2 as independent observations or sum with actual insured claims. Candidate is not an insured loss calibration dataset without selection/inflation and project-class controls.

entries.name: APRA intermediated general insurance statistical series through June 2026
entries.spatial_scope: Australia, APRA-authorised general insurance, Lloyd's and reported unauthorised foreign insurance intermediated channel; some reported regional categories for foreign risks
entries.temporal_scope: December 2010 to June 2026 series, official 2026-09-29 release; semiannual
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public APRA XLSX database and explanatory notes, industry aggregate intermediated placements; foreign insurer segments may be shown by region, exemption, atypical risk and reason
entries.note: This official intermediated-business publication is distinct from APRA's older insurer institution-level series. It is industry-level, not a geolocated named insurer portfolio or customer-level policy file; its regional breakdown for unauthorised foreign insurers must not be conflated with all Australian property risks. Do not assume 2024-2026 institution-level disclosure remains available: APRA notes the quarterly institution-level general-insurance series is on hiatus. Inspect workbook and licence before numerical reuse.

entries.name: LINZ NZ Property Boundaries rated property / title / parcel polygon composite
entries.provider: Toitu Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ)
entries.spatial_scope: New Zealand; coverage built from rating units, supplemented with property titles then parcels; it is not an all-building footprint layer
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously revised weekly; inspected layer shows 2026-10-22 update, and publisher category shows 2026-10-29; freeze one exact snapshot for joins
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Layer 122657 ~2,718,135 polygon features at inspected vintage; attributes include geom, source, source_id, unit_of_property_id, title_no, parcel_id, area; NZGD2000 EPSG:4167
entries.note: Official layer composes rating units, titles and fallback parcels. Some rows have null unit_of_property_id (title/parcel fallback), so a DVR equality join has unknown selective coverage. Property polygon is not roof footprint, single building or insured asset. Keep source category, unit ID, geometry validity, CRS transformation and source-vintage; exact count changes weekly. Source page advertises CC BY 4.0 but rights/scientific review for intended data pipeline is still pending; no rows published in Git.

entries.name: LINZ NZ Properties Property-Building Reference
entries.provider: Toitu Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ)
entries.spatial_scope: New Zealand buildings with an official reference to a unit of property; linked stock is not complete for every building
entries.temporal_scope: Official table 119620 updated 2026-09-24 at inspected source, with weekly update schedule
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Non-spatial PDMF property-to-building relationship table 119620 with id, unit_of_property_id and building_id; 5,029,306 rows at inspected snapshot
entries.note: Official publisher states unit_of_property_id -> building_id from NZ Building Outlines, not one-to-one: one property can relate to multiple buildings and physical relationships change through time. This product contains no geometry; join building_id to an exact-vintage NZ Building Outlines layer. Do not multiply or evenly spread full rating/insured value across bridge rows or label each row an insured structure. Freeze weekly releases and test missing/duplicate keys and join cardinality before use.

entries.name: LINZ NZ Building Outlines current mainland roof-footprint polygons
entries.provider: Toitu Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ)
entries.spatial_scope: Mainland New Zealand, close to nationwide except high mountain/Fiordland/Stewart and Chatham gaps; aerial-vintage dependent
entries.temporal_scope: Current published layer 101290 last updated 2026-05-18 at inspected source; capture_source_from/to dates can be years older
entries.resolution_or_granularity: ~3,236,141 vector polygons in NZGD2000 / NZTM2000 EPSG:2193; building_id, type/use and source capture dates; roof outlines >=10 square metres, may include garages and sheds
entries.note: Polygon represents imagery-derived roof outline, not assured wall or insurable building count; garages/sheds included and boundaries may lag real construction years. For property-value link use table 119620 at compatible revision and record building_id, imagery capture dates, coverage gaps, topology, duplicates and current-version mismatch. This is an exposure geometry candidate only, not insured TIV or policy holder evidence.

entries.name: LINZ NZ Building Outlines All Sources historical imagery cohorts
entries.provider: Toitu Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ)
entries.spatial_scope: Mainland New Zealand historical imagery coverage and gaps, not complete nationally for every year
entries.temporal_scope: Layer 101292 last updated 2026-05-18 at inspected source; includes multiple image-year states per location
entries.resolution_or_granularity: ~6,634,223 historical/current vector outlines with building_outline_id, building_id, capture window and begin/end lifespan or lifecycle; EPSG:2193
entries.note: This is explicitly multi-vintage, not 6.6M concurrent buildings; using all rows as a single exposure portfolio would double-count replaced/removed buildings. Datasource reports chronology of image capture and evolving outline IDs; lifecycle table stopped updates after January 2025. A pre-event CAT validation must exclude later-observed footprints, handle splits/merges and uncertain capture dates. No model input permitted from this candidate by catalogue alone.
